svg.title: The chunk format, container version 3
svg.text: record: u8 mode, u8 fallback, u16 0, u32 0, u64 payload bytes (payloads padded to 4 bytes); dates in s since 1970
(b) the 17 fields of the test chunk (tests/conftest.py): 133 680 bytes
payload bytes to scale; the 10 payloads of at most 64 bytes are the hairlines before EXTRA
(c) the LATTICE payload of T_2M: 6 628 bytes
this payload: 5 structure steps, 5 tables, rANS precision 10 bits, m = 3, 2 cross terms (sources FIS and PMSL), no mask term
steps: per step u8 n_ctx, table map, thresholds, W (i16), C (i32), per range u32 rANS bytes and escape units
frozen (container version 3): every offset, type and order above, the mode codes and the decode rule.
not frozen: what the encoder writes into them (weights, tables, contexts, which terms, sizes).
